verses.1: And I opened my eyes and looked around. And there were four horns!
verses.2: And he said to the angel who spoke to him, “What are these things?” The angel replied, “These are the branches that have been cut off from Judah, from Israel, and from Jerusalem.”
verses.3: And Jehovah showed me four stages.
verses.4: And he said, “What are these people here for?” He replied, “These are those who have slandered the Jews. They will not be able to carry their heads on their shoulders anymore.” They came to take them by the ears, so that they might be separated from the people of the nations who slander the land of the Jews.
verses.5: And I opened my eyes and looked around. There was a man standing there, with a rope in his hand.
verses.6: And he said, “Go ahead.” Then he told me to go and see Jerusalem, to see how wide and long it was.
verses.7: And behold, the angel who spoke to me came forth, and another angel came forth to speak with him.
verses.8: And he said to him, “Go and tell the young man from Galilee, ‘Behold, Jerusalem will be filled with people and animals.’”
verses.9: And I will be with her. May the LORD’s fire surround her, and may she be protected from all harm.
verses.10: Holy, holy! May they be rescued from the land of the dead. May Jehovah say that I have separated you from the four winds of heaven.
verses.11: Oh, Zion, which is lifted up in the sky, sits in the midst of the heavens.
verses.12: For as Jehovah, the Almighty, said: “After I have sent you to the nations that are taking over you, because those who touch you will be touched in their own eyes.”
verses.13: For I am raising my hand over them; they will become offerings for their worship. And know that Jehovah, the God of hosts, has sent me.
verses.14: I will rejoice and be glad in Zion, for I will dwell among you, says the LORD.
verses.15: And many nations will join themselves to Jehovah on that day. They will become my people, and I will dwell among them. You shall know that Jehovah, your God, has sent me to you.
verses.16: And Jehovah divided Judea between the people, as a portion of the Holy Land. He also chose Jerusalem as its capital.
verses.17: All things are under the control of Jehovah, for they are created from His holiness.
